collection.title: Renault Megane Hatchback 2006 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Renault Megane Hatchback 2006 to 2008 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Megane which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
